sources.locator: Ordering Information - Global Part Number section: YAGEO BRAND ordering code, GLOBAL PART NUMBER (PREFERRED) figure and code tables (1) size, (2) tolerance, (3) packing style, (4) rated voltage, (5) capacitance value
sources.evidence_extract: YAGEO BRAND ordering code, GLOBAL PART NUMBER (PREFERRED): CC xxxx x x X7R x BB xxx. (1) size 0603 (1608); (2) K = +/-10%; (3) R = Paper/PE taping reel, reel 7 inch; (4) 9 = 50 V; (5) 2 significant digits + number of zeros (104 = 10 x 10^4 pF = 100 nF). Footer www.yageo.com, Mar. 6, 2026 V.27. Hash comparison: A5 baseline: none. A5 recorded no datasheet URL or SHA-256 for C14663 (engineering/a5/passive_evidence/C14663.snapshot.json carries no dataManualUrl/dataManualOfficialLink and engineering/a5/electronics/source_provenance.json has no entry), so there is no A5 hash to compare; bytes inspected now (2026-11-08, HTTP 200, Content-Type application/pdf, 1643453 bytes, starts %PDF-, 29 pages): 3aa10c5d01fbea28f638f1e4bca56a14b9b3342f593d68641830b1cbdb3720e6 - no A5 baseline.
